verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v1: ʾasʾaluka llāhumma dhā n-naʿmāʾi yā ʿāliyā ṣ-ṣifāti wal-ʾasmāʾi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v2: laka s-sanā wal-ʿizzu wal-kamālu laka th-thanā wal-ḥamdu wal-jamālu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v3: laka ʾilahī qudratu qadīru laka ʾirādatu fadhī jadīru
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v4: hab lʿubaydika lladhī yukhāṭibu laka l-khuṭūbu nafsahu tuʿāṭibu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v5: mahmā naḥā ʾilayka ʾan lā tuʿriḍā ʿanhu ʾidhā lā yaẓfaran minka r-riḍā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v6: man ʾamma naḥwaka ʿalī wāhtammā takuffu ʿanhu rabbi ghammā hammā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v7: ṣalli ʿalā man ʾunzila dh-dhikru l-ḥakīm ʿalayhi ʿayni r-raḥamāti wan-naʿīm
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v8: lahu mina l-marātibi l-ʿulyā ʿajab ṣalli ʿalā l-musrā bihi yuqḍā ʾarab
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v9: lahu mina l-mawāhibi l-ʿaliyyah mā yabharu l-ʿuqūla wal-maziyyah
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v10: ʿāfī l-jarāʾimi wayā kāfī l-balā fāghfir lanā wajaddidan bimā balā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v11: lā budda tughshīnā ʿani l-ḥisābi walā l-munāqashati wal-ʿitābi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v12: l-ʿafwu ʿafwuka bilā mutābaʿah ʾiḥsānuka l-karīmu baʿdu tābiʿah
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v13: sallim ʿalā ʾāyati kulli muʿtabir wan-naʿmahi l-ʿuẓmā likulli muntaṣir
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v14: yadkhulu man ʾatā bihi l-buyūtā lirabbinā d-dukhūla lan yafūtā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v15: yarjū mina l-mawlā laṭāʾifa l-minan yanjū bikulli ḥālati mina l-fitan
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v16: danāka min dunuwwihi dunuwwu man tawassala bihi ʿuluwwu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v17: naṭlubu naṣraka ʿalā l-ʾaʿdāʾi sahal lanā ʿibādata l-ʾaʿḍāʾi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v18: udʿūniyā stajib lakum ʾanzaltā waʾanta lā tukhlifu mā waʿadtā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v19: mujību yā qarību yā samīʿu māniʿu yā dāfiʿu yā rafīʿu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v20: ḥafīẓu yā mujību yā karīmu qawiyyū yā matīnu yā ʿalīmu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v21: mā qāṣidu l-kunūzi wal-khazāʾini walajja ʾillā qad ḥawā min bāṭini
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v22: man ʾamma rabbī sāḥata l-karīmi lā budda ʾan yaḥūza bin-naʿīmi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v23: dayyānu yā dāʾimu rabbī wārithu bāsiṭu yā bāriʾu rabbī bāʿithu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v24: ʾaqil liʿabdika dh-dhalīli l-ʿatharāt ḥaythu l-ʿuthūru jāʾahu bil-hafawāt
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v25: lam yubqi baḥru l-ʿafwi wal-kabāʾiri min sayyaʾātihi walā ṣ-ṣaʿāʾiri
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v26: faḍāʿifan rabbī lahu bil-ḥasanāt waʾalḥiqannahu biʾūlī d-darajāt
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v27: ʾadʿū bijāhi ṣ-ṣādiqi l-waʿdi l-ʾamīn yā barru yā māliku wal-ḥaqqu l-mubīn
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v28: taftaḥu yā fattāḥu bil-miftāḥi wal-fātiḥi l-muʿlaqi wal-fattāḥi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v29: ḥamīdu yā waliyyū yā shakūru raḥīmu yā ḥalīmu yā ṣabūru
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v30: lanā biʾabwābi r-riḍā yā fāṭiru ʾabwāba khayrāti ʾilahī qāhiru
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v31: man dhā lladhī yadʿūka mā tujību mā ghāʾibu ʿanka ʿalī yaghību
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v32: ʾashāʾu ʾanta qad tashāʾu wayakūn mā shiʾita rabbī mā ʾashāʾu lā yakūn
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v33: ʾahlik ʿidānā muhlika l-farāʿinah wadammiranhum muhlika d-dajājilah
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v34: ghāfiru yā sattāru yā tawwābu dhā l-jūdi wal-karami yā wahābu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v35: laṭīfu yā raḥmānu yā llāhu walā yakhfā ʿalayka l-ḥālu minnī lā walā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v36: qawiyyū qawwinī ʿalā ṭ-ṭāʿāti ʿan kasali wal-ʿajzi wad-daʿāti
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v37: walī t-tijā ʾilayka yā maljānā walī rtijāʾu l-faḍli yā manjānā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v38: ʾaʿidh ʿubaydaka bimā qad yastaʿīdh mina sh-shurūri ʾanta ḥukmuka nafīdh
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v39: la taḥmilan ʾiṣrā ʿalaynā rabbanā kamā ḥamaltahu lladhīna qablanā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v40: khudhan lanā yā rabbanā bil-faḍli walā tuʾākhidhan lanā bil-ʿadli
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v41: ʾaḥsin ʿawāqiba l-ʾumūri khāliqī lanā ʾajirnā rabbanā yā rāziqī
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v42: tijāhaka l-karīma qad thanaytu birukbatayyā mathalā wajjahtu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v43: munyatu hadhā l-ʿabdi ʾan tumītah ʿalā ṭarīqi shaykhihi ʾadkhaltah
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v45: mumiddi kulli ʾawliyā r-raḥmani ʾabī l-ʿabbāsi ʾaḥmada t-tijānī
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v46: ʾīlu ḥshuran lanā ʾayā maʿbūdu fī zumrati sh-shaykhi ʾayā wadūdu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v47: salāmu yā subbūḥu yā ʿaẓīmu qayyūmu yā qādiru yā raḥīmu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v48: bisirri dhātika wabīlʾasmāʾi sirri ʾusāmī s-sirri dhī ṣ-ṣafāʾi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v49: qābilu yā shadīdu yā dhā ṭ-ṭawli dhā l-quwwati l-matīnu yā dhā l-ḥawli
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v50: naḥnu ʾataynāka watastaghīthu bifaḍlika l-wāsiʿi yā mughīthu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v51: ʾasbil ʿalaynā thawba sitri sātiru waʾanta yā rabbi ʾilaynā nāẓiru
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v52: ṣalli ʿalā l-maḥmūdi dhī s-siyādah wal-maḥtidi l-ḥasabi dhī l-majādah
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v53: rafaʿtu ṣawtī wawasīlatī ḥabī buka wathabbiti r-rajāʾa fī ḥubī
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v54: ʾaʿṭi lanā t-tawfīqa wal-ʾiʿānah ʾaddi mā ʾamarta bil-ʾamānah
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v55: likay nuʾaddī rabbi bil-ḥuqūqi ḥaythu ʿalaynā l-ḥaqqu lil-makhlūqi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v57: qaṣadtu naḥwaka wabīlmaʿāṣī mushtamilā yā ʾākhidha n-nawāṣī
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v58: qad ʾaḥsana l-ʿabdu bika ẓ-ẓunūnā fī tī watilka lā yarā l-futūnā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v59: bisirri mā mananta bil-ʿibādi ʾatmim lanā l-ʾanwāra dhā l-ʾayādī
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v60: ʾukhāṭibu l-muʿīna man lahu l-khiṭāb bdhāthi liḥubbahi wayustaṭāb
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v61: laṭīfu yā llāhu ʿalī ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadi khayri l-warā lladhī ʿalā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v62: ḥaqqu l-wakīlu l-jāmiʿu l-jalīlu waliyyū yā muhayminu l-jamīlu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v63: qāʾimu yā bāqī ʿaliyyū kāfī quddūsu yā ʿazīzu yā muʿāfī
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v64: qad ḍiqtu dharʿā rabbi min dhunūbi muʿtarifā bihā wamin ʿuyūbi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v65: wasiʿati r-raḥmahu wal-ghufrānu lā taqnaṭū qawluka yā raḥmanu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v66: ʾaṭāʿati n-nafsu ʿalā ʾamri l-hawā walā tubāli rabbanā bidhā n-nawā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v67: liʾannaka l-maʿbūdu ḥaqqā lā siwāk yuʿbadu rabbī tasmaʿu lladhī daʿāk
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v68: hādī l-barāyā sayyida l-ʾakwāni ṣalli ʿalayhi khāliqa l-ʾinsāni
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v69: ʾawwalu yā ʾākhiru yā raqību l-faradu l-mughnī wayā ḥasību
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v70: dafʿuka ʿannā kayda ḥāsidi ḥasad waʿānidi wakulli ḥāqidi ḥaqad
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v71: yā wāḥidu ẓ-ẓāhiru bāṭinu l-ʾaḥad yā mutaʿālī rabbanā llāhu ṣ-ṣamad
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v72: ʾadir lanā yā rabbi ʾaflaka l-ʾijā bahi bdaʿwatī lisānā wal-ḥijā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v73: lā taḥrimannā rabbanā ghtirāfā min fayḍi ʾanwāri ʾawi rtishāfā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v74: ʾalḥaḥtu ʾasʿaftu ladayka dāʿiyā taqarrubā lā tatrukannī nāʾiyā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v75: ṣalli ʿalā sh-shafīʿi dhī ṣ-ṣidqi l-ʾabar wal-karami l-maṣdūqi fī kulli khabar
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v76: ramaqa ṭarfuhu s-samāʾa mahmā wulida war-rutabu ʾaʿlā l-marmā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v77: ʾajib duʿāʾa dhī kāʾābati ḥaraj wājʿal lahu min makhraji rabbī faraj
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v78: ṭuwiyati l-ʾasā ʿalā l-qulūbi ldahrinā l-khaʾūni wal-qalūbi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v79: kafā r-raʾūfu rabbunā wakīlā wabīlladhī waʿadtahu kafīlā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v80: ʾarjū bijāhi ṭaha khayri l-mursalīn ʾursila raḥmaha hudā lil-ʿālamīn
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v81: luṭfā jamīlā rabbi wal-ḥimāyah waḥirsaka d-dāʾima wal-wiqāyah
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v83: sarīʿu yā mubdiʾu man lahu l-qdam yā wājidu lladhī qada wjada l-ʿadam
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v84: tarḥamunā biraḥmahi tughnīnā ʿamman siwāka suʾulanā tuʿṭīnā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v85: qaṣura bāʿī rabbi ʿan tatmīmi mā qad ʾatā ʿalayyā min taʿẓīmi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v86: yuʿʿaẓamu sh-shayʾu lladhī ʿaẓẓamtah subḥānaka llāhumma mā ʾamartah
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v87: (mā qaddarū l-ʾilaha ḥaqqa qadrih) faqawluka l-karīmu ḥāwī sirrihi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v88: walā tulāḥiẓ baynanā sūʾa l-ʾadab waʿadama l-ʾitmāmi mā binā wajab
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v89: ʿalā ṭarīqi r-rushdi wan-najāti thabbit bihadhā l-ʿabdi ʿan ṭughāti
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v90: lam yazali l-ʿabdu biʿiṣmahi l-ʿalīm lāhī n-nawāʾibi biminnati l-ʿaẓīm
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v91: llāhu ʾakbaru waʿazza jallā subḥāna man jalāluhu tajallā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v92: ʾanʿamanī mā lam ʾuṭiq bishukrihi rabbiyā wal-munʿimu lā min fikrihi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v93: ʾaḥmaduhu ḥamdā yuballighu ʿalā riḍwānihi l-wāsiʿi ḥaqqā ʾamalā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v94: lā ziltu fī s-sāʿāti wal-ʾawqāti ʾadʿūhu lil-ḥājāt wal-ʿillāti
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v95: huwa yujību ʿabdahu l-miskiynā ʾatā ʾilayhi yabtaghī t-tamkīnā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v96: yuʿṭī walā manʿa limā ʾaʿṭāhu walā ʿaṭā limanʿihi ḥibāhu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v97: ḥakīmu yā ḥayyū wayā ḥalīmu kabīru yā ṣādiqu yā raḥīmu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v98: qadīru yā khabīru yā baṣīru mudhillu yā ʿadlu wayā naṣīru
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v99: qābiḍu yā khāfiḍu rabbī jāmiʿu muqsiṭu waḍ-ḍārru r-rashīdu nāfiʿu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v100: qahāru yā ghaffāru yā muʿīdu muntaqimu l-ʿafuwwu yā majīdu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v101: dalīlu kulli mutaḥḥayiri waqaf yatīhu fī falātihi kaman sakhaf
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v102: rabbī qaḍayta faraḍītu bil-qaḍā taḥkumu mā tashā faḥukmuka maḍā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v103: hal min munāziʿi fadhāka ghayrī fawwaḍtu ʾamrī laka nāfī ḍ-ḍayri
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v104: yawma mruʾu yanẓuru mā qad qaddamat yadāhu wan-nafsu bimā qad ʿamilat
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v105: wakun ʾilahī tajʿalu l-ʾaṣābiʿā lis-sirri ʾākhidhā yamīnī tābiʿā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v106: muḥammadi khayri l-bariyyati ʾatā dīnaka qad daʿā lahu kulla fatā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v107: qaddamahu jamīʿu l-nbayāʾi war-rusli fī riḍāka l-tqiyāʾi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v108: durija mā durija min ṭibāqi lahu wayaʿruju ʾilā l-ʾāfāqi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v109: ʾarāhu rabbu l-ʿarshi mā yarḍāhu kadhā mina l-ʾanwāri mā yaghshāhu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v110: rabbī rasūluka n-nabī l-ʾummiyyū ṣalli ʿalayhi sh-shāfiʿu l-marḍiyyū
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v111: hudā bashīru wamubashsharu nadhīr waṭāhiru muṭaharu badru munīr
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v112: yāsīnu ṭaha ḥāshiru waʿāqibu wamuqtafi munji wanajmu thāqibu
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v113: ʾajib lanā bijāhi bābika l-ʿaẓīm ʿayni n-naʿīmi waṣ-ṣirāṭi l-mustaqīm
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v114: laṭīfu yā muʿṭī faʾatmim gharaḍā lanā kadhā l-murādu ḥaythu ʿaraḍā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v115: ʿalā l-muqaffī sayyidi s-sādāti ṣalli wasallim wāhiba l-hibāti
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v116: ẓamʾānu māʾi l-waṣli yā rabba l-falaq fanajjihi mawlāyā min sharri l-qalaq
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v117: yadʿūka man yurattibu l-ḥurūfa min ṣalati fātiḥi duʿāʾuhu qamin
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v118: muʿtamidā biʿawnika l-karīmi watamma qaṣduhu bidhā l-manẓūmi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v119: ṣalli ʿalā s-sayyidi dhī l-miʿrāji sallim ʿalā dhī sh-sharʿi wal-minhāji
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v44: lāzama mā lāzama ḥattā nālā min rabbahi mā nālahu nawālā
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v56: ḥafẓa lladhī ʾawdaʿta min sharāʾiʿi wayā badīʿu rabbi dhā l-badāʾiʿi
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v82: mughīthu yā muḥyī l-mumītu l-māliku yā man jarā biyadhi l-mamāliku
verses.hurufu-salati-l-fatihi-c1-v120: wāʾālihi waṣaḥbihi l-muntakhabīna r-rākīʿīna s-sājidīna l-muhtadīna
